answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake and a per-epoch reputation delta, so fresh keys start at the nadir of trust and must accrue history before weight. As the tide of new registrations rises, a peer-attested quorum samples cross-links and flags clusters sharing stake provenance or timing, throttling their influence. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
